Roanoke Valley Riveters (women's mountain bike ride)

Roanoke, VA · Mountain bike

Roanoke Valley Riveters (women's mountain bike ride) is a mountain bike group ride in Roanoke, VA. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Bennett Springs parking lot, Carvins Cove.

Next ride Wed, Oct 7, 6:00 PM EDT

Checked Oct 1, 2026. Confirmed against the sources at the foot of this page. Check the host's page before you go

How we know

Roanoke Outside's guide to group rides, updated June 8, 2026, lists the Riveters on Wednesdays at 6:00 pm at the Bennett Springs lot at Carvins Cove (page fetched Oct 1, 2026). A secondary page; the group's own Facebook page was not readable.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Roanoke Valley Riveters (women's mountain bike ride) group ride

A group for women mountain bikers of any skill level, sponsored by Just The Right Gear. It also holds events for women-identifying and non-binary riders.
